full_text_en:
Guiding Case No. 253

Huizhou Mou Industrial Co., Ltd. v. Huizhou Mou Water Quality Purification Co., Ltd. and Qiu — enforcement implementation case

(Discussed and approved by the Adjudication Committee of the Supreme People's Court, issued on April 7, 2025)

**Keywords**  
Enforcement; enforcement implementation; designated enforcement; enforcement conciliation

**Key Points for Enforcement Implementation**

1. Where enforcement work cannot be effectively advanced due to factors such as the property to be executed being located in another locality, and where enforcement by the people's court of the place where the property is located is more conducive to carrying out enforcement work in a timely and effective manner in accordance with law, the common higher-level people's court may designate the case to be enforced by the people's court of the place where the property to be executed is located.

2. Where the property to be executed involves a livelihood project and requires assistance and coordination from local government functional departments, the people's court may strengthen coordination and collaboration with relevant departments, guide the parties to reach an enforcement conciliation agreement such as installment payment, and reserve necessary funds to maintain the normal operation of the livelihood project.

**Basic Facts**

In March 2023, Huizhou Mou Industrial Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Huizhou Mou Industrial Company) filed a lawsuit, requesting Huizhou Mou Water Quality Purification Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Huizhou Mou Purification Company) and its legal representative, Qiu, to pay overdue货款 (goods payment) of RMB 10,410,000 (the currency unit hereinafter is the same) and corresponding interest. After mediation by the Huicheng District People's Court of Huizhou, Guangdong Province, the parties reached a mediation agreement for installment payment, which was confirmed by a civil mediation document. As Huizhou Mou Purification Company and Qiu failed to fulfill the payment obligation, Huizhou Mou Industrial Company applied to Huicheng District People's Court for compulsory enforcement.

During the enforcement process, Huicheng District People's Court investigated the property of the persons subject to execution, Huizhou Mou Purification Company and Qiu, and found that there was a small amount of deposit in the bank accounts under their names; the registered place of the person subject to execution, Huizhou Mou Purification Company, was located in Huiyang District, Huizhou; and the four immovable properties registered under the name of the person subject to execution, Qiu, were also all located in Huiyang District, Huizhou. Huicheng District People's Court, in accordance with law, sealed up the bank accounts under the names of the persons subject to execution and the aforementioned immovable properties under Qiu's name. Upon application by Huicheng District People's Court, Huizhou Intermediate People's Court of Guangdong Province designated this case to be enforced by Huiyang District People's Court of Huizhou.

During the enforcement process, upon investigation and verification, it was found that all four immovable properties registered under Qiu's name had been mortgaged, and the value of the properties was obviously insufficient to cover the creditor's rights of the mortgagee, making their auction a non-beneficial disposition; the person subject to execution, Huizhou Mou Purification Company, undertook the government's sewage treatment project, responsible for 60% of the sewage treatment in the Danshui urban area of Huiyang District, and enjoyed creditor's rights for receivable project payments. The project payments were paid monthly by the Huiyang District Housing and Urban-Rural Construction Bureau (hereinafter referred to as Huiyang District Housing Bureau) by installments into the bank account of Huizhou Mou Purification Company, which had been frozen. However, Huizhou Mou Commercial Bank, Huiyang Branch (hereinafter referred to as Mou Bank Huiyang Branch), a third party, enjoyed a pledge right over the aforementioned receivable project payments. The person subject to execution used the received project payments to maintain business operations and promote the sewage treatment project, and made monthly repayments to the pledgee, Mou Bank Huiyang Branch, to settle its creditor's rights. After Huiyang District People's Court froze the account of Huizhou Mou Purification Company that received project payments in accordance with law, the applying party for enforcement, Huizhou Mou Industrial Company, repeatedly applied for compulsory enforcement of the project payments. Huiyang District Housing Bureau believed that if the project payments were compulsorily enforced, it would directly affect the progress of the enterprise's sewage treatment project, thereby affecting the normal life of nearly 200,000 residents in the Danshui urban area, and would also have a negative impact on the local ecological environment.

To avoid affecting the normal business operations of the enterprise, ensuring the normal life of residents, protecting the local ecological environment, and safeguarding the lawful rights and interests of the pledgee, Huiyang District People's Court actively organized consultations between the parties and the pledgee and guided the parties to reach an enforcement conciliation agreement in July 2023. The conciliation agreement stipulated that, on the premise of ensuring the normal production and operation of Huizhou Mou Purification Company, ensuring the normal construction of the related sewage treatment projects, and ensuring the monthly repayment of the pledgee's creditor's rights, Huiyang District People's Court would deduct and transfer a total of RMB 9,670,000 from the bank account of Huizhou Mou Purification Company in four installments monthly and return the money to Huizhou Mou Industrial Company; Huizhou Mou Industrial Company agreed to waive its claim for interest and agreed to lift the freeze on the bank accounts under the name of Huizhou Mou Purification Company and the seal-up of the immovable properties under Qiu's name.

**Execution Result**

In October 2023, Huizhou Mou Industrial Company received the final payment, the conciliation agreement was fully performed, and this case was closed as completed enforcement.

**Reasons for Execution**

The main property of the persons subject to execution in this case was located in another locality and involved a livelihood project. To ensure the smooth and steady advancement of the enforcement work, the higher-level people's court should strengthen overall coordination.

First, where enforcement by the people's court of the place where the property to be executed is located is more conducive to advancing the enforcement work, the case may be enforced by the people's court of the place where the property to be executed is located. For cases where the property to be executed is located in another locality, to more effectively advance the enforcement work and protect the lawful rights and interests of the winning party, the case may be reported to the common higher-level people's court for designation to be enforced by the people's court of the place where the property to be executed is located. In this case, after Huicheng District People's Court initiated enforcement upon case filing, it discovered that the property to be executed was all located in Huiyang District and therefore reported to Huizhou Intermediate People's Court for designated enforcement. With a view to saving judicial resources and improving enforcement efficiency, Huizhou Intermediate People's Court designated this case to be enforced by Huiyang District People's Court.

Second, where the property to be executed involves a livelihood project, the people's court should handle the matter properly. In this case, during the enforcement process, Huiyang District People's Court discovered that the project payments to be executed were related to the local sewage treatment project, and compulsory enforcement might affect the progress of the sewage treatment project, thereby affecting the normal life of local residents and even the ecological environment. Huiyang District People's Court fully leveraged its advantages as the local court: on the one hand, it actively coordinated with the housing and construction department to assist the court in advancing the enforcement of the case funds; on the other hand, it organized multiple consultations between the parties and the pledgee, explaining the law and reasoning, guiding all parties to seek a balance of interests, and ultimately reaching a conciliation agreement for installment payment of the project payments.

Through designated enforcement and active coordination with relevant parties, this case not only safeguarded the lawful rights and interests of the applying party for enforcement to the maximum extent, but also gained room for development for the enterprise subject to execution, while ensuring the smooth progress of the related livelihood project, achieving good enforcement results.

**Relevant Legal Provisions**

Article 235 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China (Article 231 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China as amended in 2021 is applicable to this case)  
Paragraph 2 of Article 74 of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Enforcement Work of the People's Courts (for Trial Implementation) (Fa Shi [1998] No. 15, amended in 2020)  
Articles 1 and 8 of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning Enforcement Conciliation (Fa Shi [2018] No. 3, amended in 2020)
